notes: EXAMPLE: mode=adapt_start_deck and start_deck_path are shown because this example pretends a start deck exists; a real case must fill them only when detected.start_deck is unique, start_deck_spec.ok=true and slide_count>0, per plan_guide.md section 2.1.

EXAMPLE: constraints_applied echoes invented case.json.constraints values so the {value, source} shape is visible; real runs must copy the actual case.json.constraints values and never invent audience/time.

EXAMPLE: source_slide values 1-4 stand for a synthetic 4-slide start deck; preserve_start_text=true means those slides' text must survive re-layout, font downgrade or split. Real runs must read start_deck_spec.json.slide_details[].index and text_units.
EXAMPLE: tables[0] is a synthetic 2-column table sourced from T1; adapt_pptx must emit a real OOXML a:tbl with the same shape and cell text, never a screenshot or a plain-text fallback.
EXAMPLE: confirmed_roles is false because this synthetic example has no real template or source evidence to confirm roles from.
EXAMPLE: layout_name/layout_part, unit ids (u0012/u0013/u0044/u0050), section S1, figure id F1, table id T1 and the contract_values key are invented for shape only.
EXAMPLE: font_ladder stays at or above common.FONT_FLOOR (title 2400 / body 1400 / caption 1200 / table 1200 / notes 1000, 1/100 pt).
